# Summary

Describe what this pull request changes and why. Link the issue it resolves, for example `Closes #12`.

## Checklist

- [ ] The title says what the change does in the imperative mood, for example "Add note templates"; it becomes the commit subject.
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run check`, `npm run test:unit -- --run` and `npm run test:int` pass.
- [ ] The end-to-end tests pass, or the change cannot affect them.
- [ ] New behavior has tests, including the refused cases of scope and permission checks.
- [ ] New interface texts exist in both files in `messages/`.
- [ ] Database changes are new migrations; applied migrations are never edited.
- [ ] The documentation in `docs/` describes changes that users or operators notice.
